source: Operator report; supporting media pending where indicated
summary: SP-ARDHI-26 passed inspection and was approved for commissioning on November 16, 2026 (owner-reported). The general-purpose bucket and pallet forks are tested, and the November 8 thrown track has been reinstalled with the repair reported complete. Commissioning completion sign-offs continue per the public checklist; the 42-inch grapple remains on a separate mechanical-locking hold.
readiness: Approved for commissioning as of November 16, 2026 (owner-reported). Commissioning approval is authorization to commission — not completion of every commissioning procedure and not a release for customer work. Rental availability has not been announced.

milestones.title: Delivery and uncrating
milestones.summary: Carrier delivery and crate opening are documented in the existing gallery.

milestones.title: Commissioning recovery
milestones.summary: Starting restored following battery charging after an oil-level correction. Further operating observation and inspection remain required; this is not a confirmed diagnosis.

milestones.title: First dirt-day evaluation
milestones.summary: Operator-reported bucket handling, playground-area preparation, grading, dirt movement and pallet-fork practice. Field photographs await review. A full pallet lift is not documented.

milestones.title: Inspection passed · commissioning approved
milestones.summary: Owner-reported fleet milestone: SP-ARDHI-26 passed inspection and is approved for commissioning. Bucket and pallet forks are tested; the reinstalled track repair is reported complete. Completion sign-offs continue per the commissioning checklist.

nightOps.title: V1 - Removable magnetic lights
nightOps.summary: Battery-powered magnetic lights and purple accents: 12 initially reported; eight more planned for a 20-light target. Removable side and rear placement supports inspection.

nightOps.title: V2 - Hardwired work lighting
nightOps.summary: LASFIT light bar and AUXBEAM pods are proposed for forward and wider worksite coverage, with desired amber/white capability. Factory pods stay ignition controlled; purple accents use a separate proposed circuit.

nightOps.title: V3 - Engine-off illumination
nightOps.status: Design candidate - not purchased or installed
nightOps.summary: A dedicated auxiliary battery, protected independent circuits, fused distribution, weather-resistant enclosure and compatible charging are planned. A 12V 30Ah LiFePO4 battery is a candidate, not an installed upgrade.

maintenanceSummary: Inspection passed November 16, 2026 (owner-reported). The November 8 thrown track was reinstalled following supplier guidance and the repair is reported complete; throttle travel was restored November 8; quick-change pin hardware was repaired with independent retention verification pending. Oil-level correction and restart after charging remain operator-reported. Detailed troubleshooting, defect photographs, supplier messages and warranty discussions remain in Digital HQ.
upgradeSummary: The six-tooth bucket configuration is owner-reported installed November 7, 2026; field performance testing and independent attachment safety review remain pending. Transport hooks, securing points, mirrors, extinguisher, lighting and recovery accessories remain under evaluation or procurement. The 42-inch grapple was received November 11 with hydraulic connection and jaw operation verified; its quick-attach mechanical locking remains on hold pending obstruction resolution.
mediaSummary: Delivery, crate-opening photographs and factory startup guidance remain available. Field, charging, lighting and inspection evidence awaits review; factory footage is not presented as field-test proof.
